title: ShankSectionProfile
description: The real cross-section produced by backend/jewelmind/geometry/shank/profile.py::build_profile() for one angular position around the shank. Not a JDL-facing structure — the JDL field is the single enum string band.profile; this schema documents the geometric contract that string resolves to. See docs/bible/19-shank/545-section-profile-contract.md.

profileType.description: KNIFE_EDGE and any other profile type is PLANNED, not implemented in v1.

innerRadiusMm.description: Minimum radial distance from the ring axis. For comfort_fit, this is the value at the profile's longitudinal center — the profile only ever flares outward from here, never inward, so the requested finger opening is never reduced.

outerRadiusMm.description: Maximum radial distance from the ring axis, at this section's resolved thickness.

halfWidthMm.description: Half of this section's resolved width, in the shank's local axial/width direction.

comfortFlareMm.description: Fixed constant (COMFORT_FLARE_MM in profile.py), only meaningful when profileType=comfort_fit. Not user-configurable in v1.
